the development of the Digital KnowledgeFinder, an intelligent system that uses a case-based reasoning approach to manage the experience of the scientific community.
the development of a system that can be used to support the process of scientific research.

the design of a case-based reasoning tool for scientific literature, which can support the scientific researcher in the process of problem solving, and the practitioner and the student in the process of learning.
